19th May, 1944.

Dear Miss Sercombe,

With reference to the attached, I have recently been having conversation with Mr. Hollis regarding John and Mrs. Oldag, as a result of which I believe he has referred the matter to Mr. Clarke. You may therefore think it worth while to show the latest publication to Mr. Clarke.

Yours sincerely,

Miss Sercombe,
F. 3.
